title: Primitives
note: Artifact-level mind-map: every artifact placed heuristically from concept + tier + reading order. y = concept_order (timeline); x morphs from a single column (order) to concept clusters (x_spread).

concepts.truth: a point is a decision: here, not there — but only inside a system.
a line is the claim two things are connected — and the ruler that measures it.
a line with a direction is an instruction, not a place.
three lines make the minimum enclosure — the first closed thing.
a flat surface: the field a shape is drawn upon.
the grid is the commitment to discretize — to count space.
the cube: six faces, the faceted unit of volume.
the sphere: every point equidistant from a centre.
a circle swept along a line.
a cylinder with hemispherical caps — the soft solid.
a solid with a hole — genus one, the first topology.
the regular solids: symmetry made into volume.
a base tapering to a point.
a 2D profile pushed through the third dimension.
a line that climbs as it turns.
primitives composed into something that stands.
the smooth and the grown — designed and botanical form.
a primitive that carries a symbol.
primitives combined: union, subtraction, the assembler.
a primitive you grab, drag, snap or edit.
